title: Ogre: subsystem targeting and damage
description: Attacking the Ogre: attacker chooses which subsystem to target. Each subsystem has its own defense value. Main battery: D6, Secondary: D3, Missile: D3, AP gun: D1, Treads: D1 (but need to allocate attack strength to tread damage). Destroyed subsystems are removed. Tread damage reduces movement. Ogre is destroyed when all weapons AND treads at 0.
close_reason: Ogre subsystem targeting: defense values, CRT-based damage, tread destruction, Ogre destroyed detection. 7 tests.
